editorialSummary.heading: What Klein ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: Five full-week breaks appear on the district calendar
Students return February 16 after mid-winter break and Presidents Day
paragraphs: Klein ISD's 2026-2027 student calendar runs from Wednesday, August 12, 2026, through Friday, May 28, 2027. The district has full-week fall, Thanksgiving, mid-winter and spring breaks in addition to its longer winter break.

Winter break runs December 21 through January 1, but students do not return immediately afterward. January 4 and 5 are student holidays and teacher and staff workdays, making Wednesday, January 6, the first day back. Mid-winter break runs February 8–12, followed by Presidents Day on February 15, so students return Tuesday, February 16.

Outside the major breaks, students also have no classes on September 7 for Labor Day, September 18, November 3 for Election Day, January 18 for Martin Luther King Jr. Day, March 26 and April 16. September 18, November 3 and April 16 are student holidays paired with teacher and staff workdays; March 26 is a student and staff holiday.

Grading periods end October 9, December 18, March 12 and May 28. The district PDF also lists regular hours for elementary, intermediate and high schools, but no districtwide early-release dates, report-card release dates or weather make-up day.

about.dataSource: This page is based on Klein ISD's official 2026-2027 English color calendar PDF, the district calendar page, and the district's calendar-approval announcement, checked October 5, 2026. The Board of Trustees approved the calendar November 10, 2025.
about.processing: The month grids, written date list, calendar key, grading-period table and school-hours table were checked together. Staff-only dates before the first student day and after the last student day were excluded. Official events remain separate in the event list, while the parent-facing key dates identify adjacent closures that form one continuous no-class period.
about.updates: No revision date or weather make-up day appears on the PDF reviewed for this page. Later district announcements can still change attendance dates, so the current Klein ISD calendar page controls.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference is not operated by Klein ISD. Families should confirm bell times, campus events, transportation, testing, report-card timing and emergency schedule changes with the district or their child's school.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Klein ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day for Klein ISD students is Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The first grading period begins that day. Teacher and staff workdays on August 3–11 occur before students report and are not student attendance days.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Klein ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Friday, May 28, 2027. It is also the end of the fourth grading period. The PDF does not mark the final day as an early-release day.

faqs.question: When is Klein ISD fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break runs Monday, October 12, through Friday, October 16, 2026. Students finish the first grading period October 9 and return Monday, October 19, for the start of the second grading period.

faqs.question: When is Klein ISD Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students are off for the full school week and return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: How long is Klein ISD winter break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: The official winter break covers two full school weeks, from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students also have no classes January 4 and 5 for teacher and staff workdays, so classes resume Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: Is there school in Klein ISD on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a student and staff holiday in Klein ISD. Classes resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: When is Klein ISD mid-winter break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Mid-winter break runs February 8–12, 2027. Presidents Day follows on Monday, February 15, so students remain out of class through the three-day weekend and return Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: When is Klein ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is Monday, March 15, through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students finish the third grading period March 12 and return Monday, March 22, for the start of the fourth grading period.

faqs.question: Which full-week breaks are on the Klein ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: Klein ISD has five break periods that cover a full school week or longer: fall break October 12–16, Thanksgiving break November 23–27, winter break December 21–January 1, mid-winter break February 8–12 and spring break March 15–19. Students also have January 4–5 off after winter break before classes resume January 6.

faqs.question: Is there school in Klein ISD on Election Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Tuesday, November 3, 2026, is a student holiday and a teacher and staff workday. Regular student classes resume Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: Which Klein ISD student holidays are paired with teacher and staff workdays?
faqs.answer: During the student school year, these dates are September 18, November 3, January 4–5, February 8–10 and April 16. February 8–10 are also the first three days of mid-winter break. Teacher and staff workdays on August 3–11 and June 1–3 fall outside the student attendance year.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents Day in Klein ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027, is a student and staff holiday. It follows the February 8–12 mid-winter break, and students return Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Is there school in Klein ISD on March 26, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, March 26, 2027, is a districtwide student and staff holiday. It is separate from spring break, which runs March 15–19.

faqs.question: What are the Klein ISD grading-period dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods run August 12–October 9, October 19–December 18, January 6–March 12 and March 22–May 28. The PDF gives grading-period boundaries but does not list report-card release dates.

faqs.question: When does the second semester begin in Klein ISD?
faqs.answer: Students begin the second semester Wednesday, January 6, 2027. That is also the first day of the third grading period and the first student attendance day after winter break and the January 4–5 student holidays.

faqs.question: What are Klein ISD school hours for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The PDF lists elementary hours as 8:05 a.m.–3:25 p.m., intermediate hours as 8:55 a.m.–4:15 p.m., and high school hours as 7:15 a.m.–2:35 p.m. Families should confirm campus-specific bell times with their school.

faqs.question: Does the Klein ISD calendar list early-release days?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 district PDF does not list any districtwide early-release dates. Check current district or campus communications for dismissal information not included on the PDF.

faqs.question: Does Klein ISD list a weather make-up day for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district PDF does not identify a weather make-up day. Any weather-related calendar change should be confirmed through current Klein ISD notices.

faqs.question: When are Klein ISD report cards issued?
faqs.answer: The district PDF lists grading-period end dates but not report-card release dates. Families should check current district or campus information for report-card timing.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to every Klein ISD campus?
faqs.answer: The dates here come from the districtwide school calendar. Testing, athletics, performances, bell schedules and other campus events may follow separate schedules, so families should also check their school's calendar and messages.

faqs.question: Was the Klein ISD 2026-2027 calendar officially approved?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Klein ISD Board of Trustees approved the 2026-2027 district calendar on November 10, 2025. The district said Calendar A received the majority of support across all respondent categories in its calendar survey.

faqs.question: Where can families download the official Klein ISD calendar?
faqs.answer: Use the official 2026-2027 PDF linked on this page, or visit the Klein ISD calendar page for the district's current calendar downloads and notices.
